question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?
choices: Place the mug with the left hand under the tap's nozzle and open the tap using the right handle.
Place the mug under the nozzle of the tap and open the tap from the right handle using the right hand to rinse it.
Using right hand placing the mug on the tabletop while holding the bowl in left hand.
Place the mug in the dishwasher's drawer using the right hand then release the flap from the left hand.
Place the mug in the left hand which is now holding two mugs by the handle and use the right hand to pick up another mug from the dishwasher.
correct_answer: Place the mug in the dishwasher's drawer using the right hand then release the flap from the left hand.
